studio.name: Xiao_Shihao
studio.title: PHOTOGRAPHER
studio.intro1: With a 5-year undergraduate degree in architecture and 5 years of experience in architectural design, Xiao_Shihao became an architectural photographer in 2022.
studio.intro2: His work focuses on capturing the essence of architecture and space while striving for a subtle artistic balance through the arrangement of light, composition, subject poses, spatial depth, and color.He is the 59th interviewee in Archiposition 'Chinese Architectural Photographers Series'.
studio.about1: based in Chengdu, Sichuan Province.We have maintained long-term and close collaborations with numerous renowned Architects since establishment in 2022.We believe that architects and photographers grow together through mutual partnership. In an era where architectural photography is becoming increasingly homogenized and driven by short-term, fast-paced demands, we aim to focus our energy on building long-term collaborations with clients, we delve deeply into documenting the evolution of each building and space—from conceptual design to completion,and even its post-occupancy state.
studio.intro1zh: 拥有5年建筑学本科教育背景及5年建筑设计从业经验，肖世豪于2022年转型为建筑摄影师。
studio.intro2zh: 他的作品专注于捕捉建筑与空间的本质，通过光线、构图、人物姿态、空间纵深与色彩的精心编排，追求一种克制而富有张力的艺术平衡。他是有方「中国建筑摄影师系列」第59位受访者。
studio.about1zh: MMCM STUDIO 位于四川省成都市。自2022年成立以来，我们与众多知名建筑师及设计机构保持着长期深度的合作关系。
studio.about2zh: 我们相信，建筑师与摄影师应在相互扶持中共同成长。在建筑摄影日趋同质化、短平快的当下，我们选择将精力投注于与客户建立长期的合作关系，深入记录每一栋建筑与空间的演变历程——从概念设计到竣工落成，乃至建成后的使用状态。
